page.layout: Running head at top; one printed page with a large oval portrait engraving, its ring inscription around the oval; four lines of verse below the portrait; signature mark at lower right.

main_text.p: [illegible, ~8 letters] GRATIA ARCHIDUX AUSTRIAE DUX BURGUND. BRAB. COM. FLAND.
Me Cardinalem, Episcopum, Belli ducem, Castum, Maritum, & quidquid horum denique, Intuitus[?] orbis. Sacra nummorum fames, Animusque sanus[?] gloriam macula inficit.

page.notes: The oval portrait is an engraving and has no printed text of its own apart from the ring inscription. The ring inscription is partly cut off at the left edge of the oval, so its opening words are illegible. Faint fragments of text from the page behind show through beneath the plate and at its right edge; these are not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "Intuitus" and "sanus" are marked [?].
